## Blockers/Concerns

- Subagent spawning via the model provider was blocked this session ("request blocked due to unusual activity") — all planning/execution ran inline
- Do not run `npm run build` while `next dev` is active on the same `.next` (caused a transient unstyled/500 state; fixed by restart on a clean `.next`)

## Key Learnings

- The provider (`/chat/completions`, OpenAI-compatible) streams natively; upstream SSE `choices[0].delta.content` parsing covers it, with `callProvider` as the buffered fallback
- Client SSE contract: `data: {"delta"}`, `data: {"error"}`, `data: {"done"}` — uniform regardless of upstream behavior
